fusions.name: Murmuration
fusions.desc: Sends 5 darting birds out in a spread, each dealing 3 damage and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Ceaseless Pecking
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Flying in Formation
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Slipstream
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 stamina a second for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
